title: Define question, tag, version, and payload domain types
acceptance: QuestionKind and payload structs are serde-compatible
utoipa schema derives are added where needed
notes: Added utoipa 5 (uuid+time features); api/src/domain/question.rs defines QuestionKind, QuestionStatus, Normalize, Judge (FromStr↔as_str pinned to DB CHECK strings, same pattern as Scope), plus CodeSnippet, McqPayload, FreeTextPayload, ClozePayload, Tag, Question, QuestionVersion. Question.payload kept as serde_json::Value to match the jsonb column 1:1; typed payload decoding deferred to P3-003.

title: Implement tag repository operations
notes: api/src/bank/tags.rs: pool-level list_tags / create_tag for HTTP endpoints, tx-level get_or_create_tags_tx + set_question_tags for use inside question writes. Lowercases input and dedupes in first-seen order; INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes concurrent inserts race-safe. Integration test tag_get_or_create_lowercases_and_dedupes in api/tests/bank.rs.

title: Implement question repository operations and versioning
acceptance: Live edits create question_versions row and bump version
Draft edits do not create versions
Promote and archive update status correctly
notes: api/src/bank/questions.rs: QuestionInsert/Patch/Filter types, MAX_BATCH=50, create_questions (transactional batch), get_question, list_questions (tag+status+rating filters), list_question_versions, update_question implementing the live-vs-draft versioning rule with FOR UPDATE row lock, promote_question, archive_question. Archived edits rejected with ApiError::Validation. Coverage: 4 DB integration tests in api/tests/bank.rs.

title: Add tag HTTP routes
notes: api/src/http/tags.rs: GET /tags (any auth), POST /tags (HumanScope guard so agents can't pollute namespace). Returns 201 on create (idempotent on name). All errors via ApiError.

title: Add question HTTP routes
acceptance: List, get, batch create, patch, promote, and archive routes work
notes: api/src/http/questions.rs: list/get/versions/POST batch/PATCH/promote/archive. POST + PATCH + promote + archive gated by new RequireAnyScope<WriteQuestionScopes> extractor (accepts Human OR AgentWriteQuestions); added ScopeOneOf trait + RequireAnyScope in api/src/auth/scope.rs. Idempotency middleware attached only to POST /questions via a sub-router merge.

title: Generate and serve OpenAPI foundation
notes: api/src/http/openapi.rs: ApiDoc with all P3 paths + components, bearer_auth security scheme via SecurityAddon Modify impl. GET /openapi.json wired in. Snapshot at api/openapi.yaml (13.9KB) regenerated via `make openapi` (new gen-openapi bin at src/bin/gen_openapi.rs). Drift test openapi_yaml_snapshot_matches in cargo unit tests fails CI if source and snapshot diverge. serde_yaml 0.9 added as dep.
